thread_text:
maria: Shared a quick Figma for a new 'Connection health' step in the Private setup wizard. It's a preflight that runs reachability + port ACL checks and shows a consolidated status bar. Looking for copy + a11y nits. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/priv-setup-health

josh: :eyes: I like it. A couple quick things: color alone shouldn't be the only indicator (icons + text required). Also 'All good' feels casual; suggest 'Connectivity verified'.

aisha: Copy suggestions:
- Success: "Connectivity verified"
- Partial: "Partial reachability — see details"
- Failure: "Connection failed — troubleshooting steps"
Add a one-line explanation under each status about why the port is needed.

lee: a11y notes: add aria-live on the status region so screen readers announce progress/changes. Ensure the Run checks button has a visible focus outline and the details accordion is keyboard tabbable.

sam: For the port list show both friendly name and port number (e.g., Control plane (443)). Include a compact copy button: "Copy rule set". Ops asked for CIDRs in the past.

maria: For the copy action: should we default to compact rules or full CIDR sets?

josh: Add a small toggle: Compact vs Full (CIDRs). Default to Compact to reduce noise. Tooltip: "Copies to clipboard in firewall-friendly format".

aisha: Microcopy tweak: change retry CTA from "Try again" to "Re-run checks" — clearer.

lee: Color contrast: current green fails AA at small sizes. Use a darker green and give the status icon a 3px stroke for contrast. Also ensure icons have aria-hidden if decorative and an accessible label for the status text.

maria: I'll switch to #1ea34a for green and #d64545 for errors, add icons + text, and update Figma.

sam: Add a "View raw results" link that opens a modal with curl/nc outputs so infra can triage. Example snippet to show in modal:
```
# quick TCP check
nc -vz example.redwood.ai 443
# curl for http endpoints
curl -I https://example.redwood.ai/healthz
```

maria: Sounds good. Modal should be non-blocking but keyboard-trapped while open. Where to place it? Inline under details or a separate firewall tab?

josh: Inline modal is fine. Make sure it supports keyboard open/close, traps focus, and has a close button with aria-label "Close raw results".

deploy-bot: deploy status — staging preview available at https://staging.redwood.ai/priv-setup/health-checks (build #452) :white_check_mark:

aisha: Slight heading tweak: change "Network checks" to "Connection health and prerequisites" and add subhead: "These quick checks help your firewall and routing teams confirm the rules we need."

lee: When failures occur, provide immediate next-step links ("Show firewall rules", "Contact support") and set role="alert" on the failure banner so assistive tech announces it.

maria: Plan: update Figma with new colors/icons, aria-live/role=alert, revised copy, compact/full toggle for copy, raw modal with sample commands, and rename retry to "Re-run checks". Will ping again once updated.

sam: I'll draft a short infra doc for the firewall snippet page and link it from the modal.

josh: :thumbsup: One more small UX thing: show an estimated duration near the button, e.g., "Takes ~15–30s" so users don't think it's stuck.

maria: Good call — adding that. Updated Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/priv-setup-v2-health — please review by EOD.
